purpose: Fresh validation-only transfer of the frozen PEMS H12 MambaTSv3 d24 graph to Electricity and Traffic, with seven external baselines and an exact AutoCon relation null.
research_question: Does the frozen four-token d24 MambaTSv3 graph that passed the five-seed PEMS H12 release retain high-dimensional short-horizon non-inferiority on Electricity and Traffic without architecture, training-budget, or AutoCon hyperparameter changes?
architecture: MambaTSv3AutoCon uses four non-overlapping full-history patches, one causal shared Mamba-1 scan, a low-rank shared cross-variable context, and a prediction-connected AutoCon representation. The active and null graphs are identical; only AutoCon lambda is .001 versus zero. Prediction-only evaluation does not return the auxiliary representation or execute the contrastive loss.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only transfer screen. No held-out test metric is generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A pass establishes only high-dimensional H12 validation transfer and permits a separately registered held-out test protocol. It does not establish general time-series performance, long-horizon performance, graph-aware traffic forecasting, or speed superiority over DLinear/NLinear/iTransformer.
prelaunch_gates: verify Electricity and Traffic SHA256 fingerprints and registered multivariate dimensions
verify exact active/null graph pairing with fresh seeds
verify prediction-connected AutoCon representation and lambda-only treatment contrast
verify seven external baselines disable all candidate-only AutoCon and Mamba options
verify d24 exact-shape prediction-only resource preflights before launch
keep skip_test=true and save_predictions=false for every job

resource_preflight.protocol: RTX 5090 D, FP32, device-resident B=32/L=96/H=12, 50 warm-up and 200 timed prediction-only forwards; auxiliary representation disabled.
resource_preflight.interpretation: The candidate is faster than the four named nonlinear comparators in both exact shapes. DLinear and NLinear are excluded from any speed-superiority wording.

phases.name: strong_baselines_h12
phases.purpose: Same-budget external references with candidate-only options disabled.

phases.name: d24_autocon_null_h12
phases.purpose: Exact d24 AutoCon-capable graph with relation weight zero.

phases.name: d24_autocon_active_h12
phases.purpose: Frozen d24 MambaTSv3 AutoCon graph with lambda .001.

comparison_contract.accuracy_gate: For each dataset, active must be within 2% of the strongest external baseline mean; the high-dimensional transfer branch passes only if both datasets meet this rule.
comparison_contract.autocon_gate: Active must be within 1% of its exact null. A relation-improvement claim additionally requires lower mean MSE and at least two of three paired seed wins.
comparison_contract.resource_gate: Report exact-shape prediction-only latency against TimeMixer, PatchTST, Mamba2, and iTransformer. No universal speed claim or DLinear/NLinear comparison is permitted.

stopping_rules: Do not alter d24 capacity, patching, Mamba settings, lambda, optimizer, split, seeds, or epoch budget after launch.
Stop high-dimensional transfer and do not release tests if either dataset fails the external-baseline gate.
Do not claim a standalone AutoCon accuracy gain if its exact null contrast fails.
Do not remove or replace a baseline after launch.
